description: This is a Java test class for the StreamingSessionActor, testing header interactions, timeouts, acknowledgements, and response behaviors in a streaming gateway service.

classes.name: StreamingSessionActorHeaderInteractionTest
classes.description: A parameterized JUnit test class that verifies header interactions, timeout handling, acknowledgements, and response behaviors for StreamingSessionActor.

classes.name: TestProbeForwarder
classes.description: An internal class that forwards all received messages to a specified TestProbe for verification.

methods.name: getParameters
methods.description: Provides all combinations of timeout, responseRequired, requestedAcks, and isSuccess as test parameters.

methods.name: startActorSystem
methods.description: Initializes the Akka ActorSystem before running tests.

methods.name: shutdown
methods.description: Shuts down the ActorSystem after all tests have run.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Sets up necessary mocks before each test run.

methods.name: stopActors
methods.description: Stops created actor instances after each test.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Executes the main test logic, creating the actor, sending messages, and verifying responses based on different header and timeout configurations.

methods.name: createStreamingSessionActor
methods.description: Creates and initializes an instance of the StreamingSessionActor with required dependencies.

methods.name: getModifyThing
methods.description: Constructs a ModifyThing message with specific headers for testing.

methods.name: getModifyThingResponse
methods.description: Generates a response related to the ModifyThing message, simulating success or failure.

methods.name: getExpectedOutcome
methods.description: Determines the expected HTTP status code based on current test parameters.

methods.name: getStatusCode
methods.description: Extracts the actual HTTP status code from a SessionedResponseErrorOrAck object.
